title: Invoke-handler tests must stub batch_get_trace_infos for the trace-binding lookup
answers: scorer invoke tests fail after adding trace ownership check
mock tracking store trace lookup in invoke handler tests
why does test_invoke_scorer_submits_jobs return wrong trace experiment
how to test scorer invoke with trace_ids
body:
Convention: _invoke_scorer_handler now calls tracking_store.batch_get_trace_infos before submitting a job, so every invoke test that reaches submission must stub it.
Set mock_tracking_store.batch_get_trace_infos.return_value to TraceInfo objects whose trace_location is EntityTraceLocation.from_experiment_id(<the request experiment_id>); otherwise the mock returns a MagicMock and the binding check behaves unpredictably.
Assert the lookup with assert_called_once_with on the de-duplicated trace id list, and assert the forwarded experiment via mock_submit.call_args.kwargs["params"]["experiment_id"].
For foreign-trace cases, use a trace from another experiment and assert status 403 and the generic message without the victim experiment id.
applies: Tests under tests/server/test_handlers.py that exercise /ajax-api/3.0/mlflow/scorer/invoke or sibling invoke handlers with trace_ids.
says: Automated tests for scoring evaluation traces are failing after adding trace ownership checks.
Scorer execution test cases fail unexpectedly during background job submission validation.
Trace evaluation tests are breaking because mock experiment lookups return unexpected values.
Ensure trace scoring tests verify that unauthorized traces from other experiments are forbidden.
search: Invoke-handler tests under tests/server/test_handlers.py exercising /ajax-api/3.0/mlflow/scorer/invoke or sibling endpoints with trace_ids must stub batch_get_trace_infos. Because _invoke_scorer_handler calls tracking_store.batch_get_trace_infos prior to job submission, mock_tracking_store.batch_get_trace_infos.return_value must be set to TraceInfo objects with EntityTraceLocation matching the request experiment_id. Tests must assert deduplicated trace lookup calls via assert_called_once_with and verify forwarded experiment IDs in mock_submit.call_args.kwargs['params']['experiment_id']. Foreign-trace test cases must supply a trace from a different experiment and assert HTTP 403 with a generic error message omitting the foreign experiment ID.
